mapper.sql: d.id, d.workspace_id, d.document_id, d.name, d.format, d.status, d.content_hash, d.active_sheet_id, active_sheet.sheet_name AS active_sheet_name, d.row_count, d.column_count, d.profile_version, d.version, d.error_code, d.error_summary, doc.storage_ref AS document_storage_ref, doc.size_bytes AS document_size_bytes, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dataset d JOIN workspace w ON w.id = d.workspace_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN document doc ON doc.id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN dataset_sheet active_sheet ON active_sheet.id = d.active_sheet_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM dataset d JOIN workspace w ON w.id = d.workspace_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN document doc ON doc.id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN dataset_sheet active_sheet ON active_sheet.id = d.active_sheet_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM dataset d JOIN workspace w ON w.id = d.workspace_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN document doc ON doc.id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN dataset_sheet active_sheet ON active_sheet.id = d.active_sheet_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.content_hash = #{contentHash} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM dataset d JOIN workspace w ON w.id = d.workspace_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN document doc ON doc.id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN dataset_sheet active_sheet ON active_sheet.id = d.active_sheet_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.content_hash = #{contentHash} AND d.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.deleted_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset SET status = 'PARSING', error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('UPLOADED', 'READY', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, dataset_id, sheet_index, sheet_name, row_count, column_count, preview_storage_ref, created_at, updated_at FROM dataset_sheet WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY sheet_index, id

SELECT id, dataset_id, sheet_id, ordinal_position, column_name, normalized_name, inferred_type, effective_type, nullable, sample_values_json, version, created_at, updated_at FROM dataset_column WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY ordinal_position, id

SELECT id, dataset_id, sheet_id, profile_version, row_count, column_count, summary_json, quality_json, profile_storage_ref, created_at FROM dataset_profile WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY profile_version DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT preview_storage_ref FROM dataset_sheet WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} UNION ALL SELECT profile_storage_ref FROM dataset_profile WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND profile_storage_ref IS NOT NULL
SELECT preview_storage_ref FROM dataset_sheet WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY id
SELECT profile_storage_ref FROM dataset_profile WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND profile_storage_ref IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM dataset WHERE status = 'PARSING' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE dataset SET status = 'READY', active_sheet_id = #{activeSheetId}, row_count = #{rowCount}, column_count = #{columnCount}, profile_version = #{profileVersion}, version = version + 1, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{datasetId} AND status = 'PARSING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE dataset SET status = 'FAILED', version = version + 1, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{datasetId} AND status = 'PARSING' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE dataset SET status = 'DELETED', version = version + 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'PARSING'

UPDATE dataset SET name = #{name}, format = #{format}, status = 'UPLOADED', active_sheet_id = NULL, row_count = NULL, column_count = NULL, version = version + 1, error_code = NULL, error_summary = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{datasetId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL

UPDATE document SET name = #{name}, media_type = #{mediaType}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, storage_ref = #{storageRef}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, parse_status = 'UPLOADED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{documentId}
